correctness.rationale: The weighted one-test objective is a positive factor times ((1+τ(a+σb))α_next−α)^2. Off its pole the unique minimizer nulls the measured residual; at the pole the objective is constant in α_next for the singular test and does not specify an update. Independence gives E|α_n|²=|α_0|²H^n; for |b|≤a the multiplier squares are both at most one and one is strictly less. Otherwise q>d>0, H(0)=1, H′(0)=-2a and H is strictly convex on the left of the pole with limit infinity. On the right both terms are strictly decreasing from an infinite total to zero. This gives exactly two positive crossings and the stated endpoint behavior. Maximizing (L−m)t/(m+Lt²), t=|tan φ|, gives (L−m)/(2√(mL)), including t=0 and the vertical line by its limit. Thus the half-angle formula is inclusive, including equal eigenvalues (all permitted rotations safe); θ=θ_c can make one stiffness vanish but the other remains positive. At either crossing the two positive squared multipliers cannot be equal: before the pole their denominators have unequal positive magnitudes at positive τ, and after the pole 1+qτ>dτ−1. Strict log concavity and the iid strong law then give a negative sample exponent at each crossing and on an adjacent unstable interval by continuity. Independent exact rational reconstruction at m=1, L=9 gives multipliers 25/319, −25/17, their squared average 31890625/29408929 and product magnitude 625/5423. The seeded checks in the source are only finite corroboration.

value.rationale: A zero minimized measurement can mask a genuine instability even with a positive heat operator and no optimization error. The exact inclusive safety angle and nonmonotone timestep range quantify when that diagnostic fails; the pathwise/moment separation explains why inspecting typical trajectories would miss it. This is a motivated sharp counterexample and classification for a minimal model, not a reliability theorem for arbitrary trial/test spaces.
